settings.password_hint: 10+ characters with a number or symbol
settings.mfa_on_body: You'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.

settings.mfa_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.mfa_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.mfa_code_or_recovery: A code from your app, or a recovery code

online.title: Online payments
online.not_configured: Online payments aren't set up on this server yet. The administrator needs to add Stripe keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET).
online.stripe_intro: Tenants pay by bank transfer (ACH) or card through Stripe. Money goes straight to your own Stripe account and then to your bank — Proppros never holds it.
online.accept_hint: Available once your Stripe account is ready.
online.pass_card_fee: Tenant pays the card processing fee ({{example}})
online.pass_card_fee_note: Bank transfers never carry a fee for tenants. Some states restrict card surcharges — check your local rules before turning this on.
online.returned_fee_hint: charged when a bank payment is returned; 0 = none
online.bank_note: no fee, takes 4–5 business days to clear
online.pending_note: {{amount}} from an earlier payment is still processing and is already deducted.
online.secure_note: You'll finish on Stripe's secure checkout page. Proppros never sees your bank or card details.
online.blocked_note: Online payments are turned off for this lease. Please contact your landlord.
online.autopay_off_confirm: Turn off autopay? You'll need to pay each month yourself.
online.autopay_status: Autopay is on — your balance is charged to {{method}} on each due date.
online.processing_note: {{amount}} is processing and will show in your statement once it clears.
online.payment_success: Thanks! Your payment was submitted. Card payments show right away; bank transfers appear once they clear.
online.autopay_enabled: Autopay is being set up. It'll show here in a moment.
online.block_label: Block online payments for this lease
online.block_hint: e.g. after serving an eviction notice; tenants can't pay online and autopay pauses.

billing.not_active: Paid plans aren't switched on yet. Everything works on the current plan — there's nothing to pay.
billing.checkout_success: Thanks! Your subscription is active. It can take a few seconds to show here.

marketing.lead: Leases, rent, maintenance and reports for independent landlords — in one calm, organized place your tenants can use too.
marketing.free_note: Free for up to 3 units. No card needed.
marketing.feature_leases_body: Every term, date and document in one place, with reminders before renewals and move-outs.
marketing.feature_rent_body: Charges post automatically each month. Record payments in seconds and see who's behind at a glance.
marketing.feature_maintenance_body: Tenants report issues with photos; you assign, track costs and keep everyone updated.
marketing.feature_reports_body: Profit and loss, rent roll and expenses by property, ready to export at tax time.
marketing.feature_portal_body: Tenants see their lease, balance and documents, and send requests — no app to install.
marketing.feature_team_body: Invite a manager, accountant or handyman and limit them to the properties they look after.
marketing.pricing_title: Simple pricing that grows with you
marketing.pricing_lead: Start free. Pay per unit only when your portfolio grows.
marketing.pricing_note: Prices in USD per unit per month. Cancel any time.

admin.search_users: Search users by name or email

signing.create_template: Create one from the starter template

templates.delete_confirm: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Documents already sent keep their text.

renewal.empty_body_mtm: This lease is month-to-month. You can offer a new fixed-term lease any time.
renewal.accept_confirm: Record that the tenants accepted? A new lease will be created.
renewal.portal_accepted: You accepted this renewal. Your landlord may send the new lease for signature.

assets.empty_body: Track the water heater, HVAC, appliances and roof with their model, age and warranty — useful when something breaks.

access.label: Label

access.empty_body: Track who holds which keys, remotes and fobs, and keep door, gate and lockbox codes in one place.

listing.fair_housing: We follow fair housing laws and don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, national origin or any other protected class.

apply.title: Rental application
apply.intro: Takes about 5 minutes. We don't ask for your Social Security number here — if we run a credit and background check, the screening company collects it securely.
apply.prior_eviction: I have been evicted or had an eviction filed against me in the past
apply.message: Anything else you'd like us to know?
apply.screening_note: By applying you agree that the landlord may verify this information and request a consumer report (credit, criminal and eviction history) through a screening company, which will ask for your consent directly.
apply.signature: Type your full name to sign
apply.consent: I confirm the information is true and complete, and I agree to the screening described above.
apply.fee_offline: The {{amount}} application fee will be collected by the landlord.
apply.thanks: Thanks, {{name}} — your application was submitted. We've emailed you a link to this page.
apply.fee_thanks: Thanks — your application fee was paid.
apply.status_submitted_body: The landlord will review your application.
apply.status_screening_body: The landlord asked for a background and credit check — see below.
apply.status_approved_body: Congratulations! The landlord will contact you about the lease.
apply.status_declined_body: The landlord has made a decision. Check your email for details.
apply.status_converted_body: Your lease is set up. Watch your email for your tenant portal invitation.
apply.screening_body: The landlord uses a screening company for credit, criminal and eviction history. It will ask for your consent and personal details directly.
apply.documents_hint: Upload pay stubs, an offer letter or a photo ID if the landlord asks (PDF or photo, up to 10 files).

vacancy.subtitle: Advertise vacant units, take applications online and turn the best applicant into a lease.
vacancy.unit_hint: Details like beds, baths and market rent are copied from the unit
vacancy.empty_body: Create a listing for a vacant unit, share the link, and applications arrive here.
vacancy.share_hint: Post this link on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, Nextdoor or in a text. Link previews show the photo and price.
vacancy.title: Headline
vacancy.description_hint: What makes this home great: layout, light, updates, neighborhood
vacancy.amenities_hint: Separate with commas — e.g. In-unit laundry, Garage, Central AC
vacancy.pet_placeholder: Cats and small dogs OK, $300 pet deposit
vacancy.app_fee_hint: Check your state's limit. Collected online if Stripe is connected
vacancy.requirements_hint: Apply the same written criteria to every applicant
vacancy.screening_url_hint: Where applicants complete their credit, criminal and eviction check (e.g. your TransUnion SmartMove link)
vacancy.fair_housing_tip: Fair housing tip: describe the home, not who should live there — avoid phrases like "perfect for singles" or "no kids".
vacancy.photos_hint: The photo you uploaded first is the cover. Landscape photos look best.
vacancy.screening_url_missing: Add a screening provider link to the listing first
vacancy.screening_emailed: Screening link emailed to the applicant.
vacancy.screening_not_emailed: Screening requested, but the email couldn't be sent — share the provider link with them directly.
vacancy.approve_confirm: Approve this applicant? They'll be emailed.
vacancy.decline_confirm: Decline this applicant? They'll be emailed.
vacancy.converted_banner: This applicant now has a lease.
vacancy.delete_app_confirm: Permanently delete this application, its screening report and files?
vacancy.include_co: Add the co-applicant as a tenant too
vacancy.invite_portal: Invite them to the tenant portal
vacancy.convert_note: Creates the tenant(s) and the lease, and closes the listing. You can then send the lease for signature from the lease page.
vacancy.converted_body: The tenants and lease are set up and the listing is closed.

screening.title: Screening report
screening.not_started: No screening yet. Request screening to send the applicant your provider's link.
screening.waiting: Waiting for the applicant to complete screening. When the report arrives from your provider, enter the results here.
screening.how: Credit, criminal and eviction reports come from a licensed screening company (for example TransUnion SmartMove). The applicant authorizes it and you receive the report from the provider.
screening.fair_use: Use the same written criteria for every applicant. HUD guidance warns against blanket bans on criminal records — consider the nature, severity and age of an offense, and arrests without conviction shouldn't be used. Some states and cities limit criminal or eviction history further.
screening.enter_intro: Copy the key results from your provider's report and attach the PDF. Only owners and managers can see this.
screening.aa_title: Decline with an adverse action notice
screening.aa_intro: When you decline (or require a larger deposit) based on a screening report, federal law (FCRA) requires a written notice. Proppros creates the letter, emails it and keeps a copy.
screening.reason_credit: Insufficient credit history or low credit score
screening.reason_criminal: Criminal history that doesn't meet our written criteria
screening.aa_agency_hint: Use the contact details your provider gives for adverse action notices.
screening.aa_score_used: A credit score was used in the decision (include it in the notice)

messages.subtitle: Conversations with your tenants, and announcements to whole properties.
messages.subject: Subject
messages.delivery_note: The tenant gets it in their portal and by email, and by text if they've turned texts on.
messages.empty_body: Start a conversation with a tenant, or wait for one to message you from their portal.

announcements.title: Announcements

notices.title: Title

notices.by_sms: Text tenants who turned texts on

notices.empty_body: Send a rent increase, notice of entry, lease violation or pay-or-quit notice from a ready-made template.

pmoveout.confirm: Give notice to move out on {{date}}?
pmoveout.submitted: You gave notice to move out on {{date}}. Waiting for your landlord to confirm.
pmoveout.acknowledged: Your landlord confirmed your move-out on {{date}}.
